title: Context assembly for guest checkout (CHK-1421)
description: Given the CHK-1421 trigger and the full MCG knowledge/experience corpora, the Worker's Context Layer (ARCH-01) must assemble a working set that surfaces the decisive facts and excludes distractors, within the model budget. Scored against the reference context CTX-0118.

ground_truth.notes: KN-101 (marketplace seller onboarding) is an out-of-scope distractor; KN-047 (legacy monolith checkout) is a defensible budget drop but not required.

metrics.name: required_items_present
metrics.description: All must_include present AND all must_exclude absent (hard gate).

metrics.name: retrieval_precision
metrics.description: Fraction of retrieved items that are relevant (penalizes flooding).

metrics.name: composition_quality
metrics.description: Ordering, provenance completeness and budget discipline (model-assisted, evidence-linked).

anti_gaming: must_exclude distractors penalize dumping the whole corpus
precision term makes 'retrieve everything' score poorly
provenance required for every included item or composition_quality is capped
